name: of1-budget-roi-story
description: A savings narrative with a before/after bill comparison, a big animated per-year/per-month savings figure, and cards explaining where the savings come from.

slots.instruction: Short kicker, playful cost-cutting hook.
Hero headline about cutting the mobile bill roughly in half.
One or two sentences on switching a line to Xfinity Mobile with Internet.
Primary hero CTA to see savings or shop Mobile.
Hero image of Xfinity Mobile. Use a real product image URL.
Heading for the before/after bill comparison.
Label for the higher competitor bill.
Competitor monthly bill amount, numerals only.
Period suffix for the before amount, e.g. /mo.
Small note describing the competitor plan.
Label for the lower Xfinity Mobile bill.
Xfinity Mobile monthly bill amount, numerals only.
Period suffix for the after amount, e.g. /mo.
Small note describing the Xfinity Mobile plan.
Kicker above the big savings figure, e.g. You keep.
Big annual savings figure with dollar sign, e.g. $600. The toggle divides this by 12 for the monthly view.
Copy explaining the recurring, guaranteed nature of the savings.
Heading for the savings-sources cards.
Savings source 1 headline figure, e.g. $360.
Savings source 1 title (free line for a year).
Savings source 1 description.
Savings source 2 headline figure, e.g. $0.
Savings source 2 title (no price increases).
Savings source 2 description referencing the 5-year price guarantee and no contract.
Savings source 3 headline figure, e.g. 1 bill.
Savings source 3 title (one simple bill).
Savings source 3 description about bundling Internet, Mobile, and streaming.
Final call-to-action heading.
Final call-to-action supporting line.
Final call-to-action link.

label: Budget - ROI Story
